name: ardenexal/fhir-tools-console-64-compat
description: Consumer harness that installs ardenexal/fhir-code-generation against the lowest declared symfony/console version.
comment: Every symfony/* package that ardenexal/fhir-code-generation declares at ^6.4 is pinned to
6.4.* here, not just the ones a given bug happened to involve. Pinning only console let
symfony/string float to 7.4 under its own ^6.4|^7.0 constraint, so the harness ran a real
generation against a string version that has pascal() (added in 7.3) and reported success
while every 6.4 consumer was failing on Call to undefined method. A partial pin tests the
lower bound of one package and the upper bound of the rest.
